opening.argument: The presentation promotes Bitconnect as a cryptocurrency compound-interest program and expressly calls it “a good investment” while urging viewers not to miss out. It describes an initial investment followed by a third-day interest payout, reinforced by a Bitconnect transaction page referring to day-three interest money. This is not merely general market commentary: it is an investment pitch tied to a referral link and an offer to coach viewers after signup. Although the referral wording is uncertain because it comes from ASR, the solicitation and claimed payout structure are clear.
